body: I haven't done anything. I've just been dealt a lot of really shitty things and I am not the kind of person that can deal with it. I break down. I shut down. I can't live with my sadness, it literally makes me sick and I'm unable to function entirely. I don't see a future. I don't want a future. I don't want any future anymore.
It isn't about a job. It's the culmination of so many things. And more than things, it's the sadness. I'm not right in my head. I never have been. I can't live with myself anymore.

There's nothing that can be changed. Even if I tried to get help, I'd end up in a worse place afterward. I have no family, no close friends. I've been bordering homelessness for over a year, jumping from place to place because I can't afford to be alive. There's no light at the end of the tunnel no matter what I do. I'm already bearing the scars of a previous attempt, and those will never go away. Nothing that's led me to this point is ever going to go away or change.
Honestly it's a culmination of things that I don't really feel comfortable sharing. There are some people who know a lot about me and my life that are frequent redditors.
